subject: Format the legend in two columns

messages.author: 7430366b64f1281b
messages.subject: Format the legend in two columns
parts:
Hi,

This is something for which I have not been able to find any pointers
in the documentation.

Is it possible to display the legend in two columns ?
I have a chart with a lot of groups, and the legend is too big to fit
in the chart - how do I break it to two columns ?

Additionally, if I only wanted to show the legend for the most
important items, how could do it ?

For illustration, here is what my chart currently looks like:
http://marc.menem.free.fr/public/country.png
I am wondering in which country portfolio 5 got invested so much in
orange (I suspect it's brazil) and eventually, I would only be
interested in the 5 main countries in the legend...


thanks
marc

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: Format the legend in two columns
parts:
Hi Marc,

It's not currently available it is on the to do. However, a legend
running of the page is normally a major warning sign, and looking at
your plot, I'd suggest taking a different approach. Firstly, I'd
suggest facetting by country - this will give you an overview and help
to decide what's important. Next, I'd suggest picking the biggest
five countries and then aggregating everything else into an other
category.

Hadley
